title.zh: 卷360 列傳一百四十七 司马𫘦 王秉韬 嵇承志 康基田 吴璥 徐端 陈凤翔 黎世序
title.en: Volume 360 Biographies 147: Si Matao, Wang Bingtao, Ji Cheng Zhi, Kang Jitian, Wu Jing, Xu Duan, Chen Fengxiang, Li Shixu
title.raw: 卷360 列傳一百四十七 司马𫘦 王秉韬 嵇承志 康基田 吴璥 徐端 陈凤翔 黎世序

sentences.zh: 列傳一百四十七

translations.literal: Biographies 147
translations.idiomatic: Biography 147

sentences.zh: 司馬騊王秉韜嵇承誌康基田吳璥徐端

translations.literal: Si Matao, Wang Bingtao, Ji Chengzhi, Kang Jitian, Wu Jing, Xu Duan
translations.idiomatic: Si Matao, Wang Bingtao, Ji Chengzhi, Kang Jitian, Wu Jing, and Xu Duan

sentences.zh: 陳鳳翔黎世序

translations.literal: Chen Fengxiang, Li Shixu
translations.idiomatic: Chen Fengxiang and Li Shixu

sentences.zh: 司馬騊，字云皋，江蘇江寧人。

translations.literal: Si Matao, style name Yungao, was a native of Jiangning, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Si Matao, whose style name was Yungao, came from Jiangning in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，大學士高晉為兩江總督，闢佐幕司章奏。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign, Grand Secretary Gao Jin served as Governor-General of Liangjiang and recruited him to his staff to draft memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianlong era, when Grand Secretary Gao Jin was Governor-General of the Two Jiangs, he brought Matao onto his staff to handle official documents.

sentences.zh: 習河事，以從九品留工效用，授山陽主簿。

translations.literal: Having mastered river affairs, he was retained on river works at subordinate ninth grade and appointed registrar of Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: He studied river conservancy and was kept on the works at subordinate ninth rank, then made registrar of Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 累遷淮安同知，仍兼幕職。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to subprefect of Huai'an, while still holding his staff post concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to subprefect of Huai'an, continuing to serve on the governor's staff at the same time.

sentences.zh: 從晉塞河，屢有功。

translations.literal: Following Jin in blocking the river, he rendered repeated meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Gao Jin in river-blocking projects and won credit again and again.

sentences.zh: 薩載繼任總督，亦倚之。

translations.literal: When Sacai succeeded as governor-general, he likewise relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: When Sacai took over as governor-general, he too came to depend on him.

sentences.zh: 五十年，奏擢江南河庫道。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year, he was memorialized for promotion to Jiangnan River Grain Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong, a memorial secured his promotion to Jiangnan River Grain Intendant.

sentences.zh: 道庫歲修六十萬，溢額則俟上聞，遇險工，廳員借帑，久輒因緣為弊，騊從容籌補，公私具舉。

translations.literal: The circuit treasury allotted six hundred thousand taels for annual repairs; surpluses awaited imperial report; when critical works arose, bureau clerks borrowed funds, which over time became entrenched abuse; Matao calmly made up deficits, and both public and private affairs were properly handled.
translations.idiomatic: The intendant's treasury set aside six hundred thousand taels a year for repairs; any excess had to be reported to the throne. When urgent works arose, bureau staff borrowed from the treasury, and over time this became a standing source of corruption. Matao replenished shortfalls without fuss, so that public business and private accounts alike were kept in order.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，遷江西按察使，在官七年，巡撫簠簋不飭，被劾多所牽連，騊以謹慎獲免。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year he was transferred to Jiangxi Judicial Commissioner; after seven years in office the governor-general's conduct was found lax and many officials were implicated in impeachments, but Matao escaped through his caution.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year he became Judicial Commissioner of Jiangxi. He served seven years while the governor-general's integrity came under scrutiny; many colleagues were dragged into the investigations, but Matao's prudence kept him clear.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，遷山西布政使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was transferred to Shanxi Financial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing he was moved to Financial Commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 二年，調山東，兼管河務。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to Shandong and given concurrent charge of river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was posted to Shandong with concurrent responsibility for river works.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，曹州河溢，命騊偕兩江總督李奉翰、南河總督康基田、前山東巡撫伊江阿同任堵塞。

translations.literal: That autumn the Caozhou River burst its banks; Matao was ordered to join Governor-General Li Fenghan of Liangjiang, Southern Rivers Governor Kang Jitian, and former Shandong Governor Yijiang'a in closing the breach.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, when the Caozhou River overflowed, he was ordered to work with Li Fenghan, Governor-General of the Two Jiangs, Kang Jitian, Governor of the Southern Rivers, and the former Shandong governor Yijiang'a to seal the break.

sentences.zh: 冬，擢河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In winter he was promoted to Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he was raised to Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy.

sentences.zh: 曹工尋合龍。

translations.literal: The Caozhou works were soon closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Caozhou breach was soon sealed.

sentences.zh: 三年春，西壩蟄，革職留任。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year the western dam failed; he was stripped of rank but kept at his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year the western dam gave way again; he was dismissed from office but left in place to serve.

sentences.zh: 疏言豫東兩岸堤工卑薄，請擇要增高，以御汛漲。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated that dikes on both banks east of Henan were low and thin and asked that key sections be raised to withstand flood crests.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that the levees on both banks in eastern Henan were too low and weak, and requested that critical sections be heightened to meet the flood season.

sentences.zh: 詔以下游不能深通，徒事加堤，斥其不揣本而齊末，曹工之蟄，由於堵築不堅，罰騊等賠修，奪翎頂，所議工事仍允行。

translations.literal: An edict held that the lower reaches could not be deepened and that merely raising dikes was futile, rebuking him for not gauging root and branch alike; the Caozhou dam's failure was due to shoddy closure; Matao and others were fined to pay for repairs and stripped of peacock feathers, yet the works he proposed were still approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied that the lower course could not be cut deeper and that piling height on the dikes alone showed he had not weighed fundamentals; the Caozhou dam had failed because the closure was poorly built. Matao and the others were ordered to pay for repairs and lost their peacock feathers, but the projects he had proposed were still allowed to proceed.

sentences.zh: 九月，睢州河溢，詔免治罪，責速塞。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Suizhou River overflowed; an edict waived punishment and ordered rapid closure.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Suizhou River broke out; the court waived penalties and demanded a swift seal.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，工竣，复頂戴，議敘，免其代賠帑銀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year the works were finished; he regained his peacock feathers, was recommended for reward, and was exempted from repaying treasury silver on others' behalf.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year the project was complete; his peacock feathers were restored, he was put forward for commendation, and he was released from paying indemnity silver.

sentences.zh: 尋卒於工次，賜卹。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died on the worksite and was granted funeral compensation.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died at the construction site and was granted posthumous relief.

sentences.zh: 王秉韜，字含谿，漢軍鑲紅旗人。

translations.literal: Wang Bingtao, style name Hanxi, was a Bannerman of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bingtao, whose style name was Hanxi, belonged to the Bordered Red Banner of the Han Army.

sentences.zh: 由舉人授陝西三原知縣，累遷河南光州直隸州知州。

translations.literal: From juren he was appointed magistrate of Sanyuan in Shaanxi and was promoted repeatedly to magistrate of Guangzhou Direct Prefecture in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: A juren degree led to his appointment as magistrate of Sanyuan in Shaanxi; he was later promoted step by step to magistrate of Guangzhou Direct Prefecture in Henan.

sentences.zh: 緣事降浙江按察司經歷，改雲南知縣。

translations.literal: For an offense he was demoted to secretary in the Zhejiang Provincial Surveillance Commission and was reassigned as a county magistrate in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: After an incident he was demoted to a clerkship in the Zhejiang Surveillance Commission, then transferred to a county post in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 累遷山西保德知州，有政聲。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to prefect of Baode in Shanxi and gained a reputation for good government.
translations.idiomatic: Further promotions brought him to prefect of Baode in Shanxi, where he earned a name for effective administration.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十五年，擢安徽潁州知府，因讞獄遲延罷職，詔以原官發江蘇，補淮安。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year of Qianlong he was raised to prefect of Yingzhou in Anhui; because a criminal case was delayed he was dismissed, but an edict sent him to Jiangsu at his former rank and he was appointed to Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 55 he became prefect of Yingzhou in Anhui. A delayed trial cost him his post, but the court ordered him to Jiangsu at the same rank, where he took up the prefectship of Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，復調潁州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he was transferred back to Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing two he was moved back to Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 會教匪犯河南，去潁州甚近。

translations.literal: When sect rebels invaded Henan, Yingzhou lay very close by.
translations.idiomatic: Just then teaching-sect rebels struck Henan, and Yingzhou was only a short distance away.

sentences.zh: 秉韜慨然曰：「同為守土臣，豈可以畛域遺害乎？」

translations.literal: Bingtao said fervently: "As officials charged with guarding the soil, how can we leave harm to a neighboring jurisdiction because of administrative boundaries?"
translations.idiomatic: Bingtao declared with feeling: "We are all guardians of the realm—how can we let a border keep us from stopping disaster next door?"

sentences.zh: 與壽春鎮總兵定柱團結鄉勇數千，勵以忠義，助糧​​餉，戰於境上，破賊走之。

translations.literal: He joined the Shouchun garrison commander Ding Zhu in organizing several thousand local militia, exhorted them with loyalty and righteousness, supplied grain and funds, fought at the border, and routed the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: With Ding Zhu, commander of the Shouchun garrison, he rallied several thousand militia, stirred them with talk of loyalty and duty, helped pay their grain and supplies, met the bandits on the frontier, and drove them off in defeat.

sentences.zh: 時大學士硃珪為安徽巡撫，器其才。

translations.literal: At the time Grand Secretary Zhu Gui was Governor of Anhui and valued his talent.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Zhu Gui was then Governor of Anhui and recognized his ability.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢廣西左江道。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted to Left River Circuit Intendant in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to Left River Circuit Intendant in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 復以在潁州失察逸犯，罣議，鐫級去官，留治江南豐、碭河工。

translations.literal: He was again censured for failing to apprehend an escaped convict while at Yingzhou, was demoted several grades and removed from office, and was retained to manage river works at Feng and Dang in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was censured again for letting a fugitive slip through his hands at Yingzhou, lost several ranks and his post, and was kept on to oversee the Feng and Dang river works in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 尋署廬鳳道。

translations.literal: Soon he served as acting Lu-Feng Circuit Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He soon acted as Lu-Feng Circuit Intendant.

sentences.zh: 洎仁宗親政，硃珪薦之，擢奉天府尹，遷河南布政使。

translations.literal: When the Jiaqing Emperor took personal rule, Zhu Gui recommended him; he was promoted to Prefect of Shuntian and then Financial Commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jiaqing Emperor began to rule in person, Zhu Gui recommended him; he became Prefect of Shuntian, then Financial Commissioner of Henan.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy.

sentences.zh: 秉韜老於吏事，治河主節費，堤埽單薄者擇要修築，不以不急之工擾民。

translations.literal: Bingtao was seasoned in official business; in river management he stressed economy, repairing only the weakest dikes and revetments at key points and not troubling the people with non-urgent works.
translations.idiomatic: Experienced in administration, Bingtao ran the rivers on a tight budget: where levees and revetments were thin, he repaired only what mattered and refused to burden the people with work that could wait.

sentences.zh: 河北道羅正墀信用劣幕舞弊，曹考通判徐鼐張皇糜費，並劾治之。

translations.literal: Hebei Circuit Intendant Luo Zhengchi trusted a corrupt private secretary who committed fraud; Caozhou Subprefectural Judge Xu Tai exaggerated expenses in alarm; Bingtao impeached and punished them both.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Zhengchi of the Hebei Circuit relied on a crooked private secretary who cheated the accounts; Xu Tai, the Caozhou judge, wildly inflated costs—Bingtao had both prosecuted and punished.

sentences.zh: 薪料如額採買，河員濫報輒駮斥，使多積土以備異漲，於是浮冒者不便其所為，言官遽論劾，詔慰勉，戒勿偏於節省。

translations.literal: He bought fuel and materials in full measure; when river officials reported excess he routinely rejected their claims, and had earth stockpiled against unusual floods; those who padded accounts found his ways inconvenient, and censors hastily impeached him; an edict comforted him and warned against excessive thrift.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased timber and supplies at the proper quota; inflated reports from river officers were regularly struck down, and he piled up earth against extraordinary rises. Officials who lived on padding the books resented him; memorialists attacked him at once. The throne sent words of encouragement but cautioned him not to lean too far toward saving money.

sentences.zh: 七年，防汛，卒於工次。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, while on flood duty, he died at the worksite.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, during flood prevention, he died on the works.

sentences.zh: 秉韜性方正，不沽名。

translations.literal: Bingtao was upright by nature and did not court reputation.
translations.idiomatic: By nature Bingtao was square-dealing and never traded on his name.

sentences.zh: 時疆吏中長麟、汪志伊並以廉著，秉韜不愜其為人，嘗曰：「長三，汪六皆名過其實，奚足貴？」

translations.literal: Among frontier officials at the time Chang Lin and Wang Zhiyi were both noted for integrity; Bingtao disliked their conduct and once said: "Chang Three and Wang Six are both more famous than they deserve—what is there to admire?"
translations.idiomatic: Chang Lin and Wang Zhiyi were then famed as honest frontier governors, but Bingtao disapproved of them and once remarked: "Chang rates a three and Wang a six—both names outrun the men. What is there to prize?"

sentences.zh: 繼其任者為嵇承志。

translations.literal: His successor was Ji Chengzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Chengzhi succeeded him in the post.

sentences.zh: 承志，大學士璜子。

translations.literal: Cheng Zhi was the son of Grand Secretary Huang.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhi was the son of Grand Secretary Huang.

sentences.zh: 由舉人官內閣中書，累遷長蘆鹽運使。

translations.literal: From juren he served as a Secretariat drafter and was promoted repeatedly to Changlu Salt Transport Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a juren in the Grand Secretariat drafting office, he rose step by step to Changlu Salt Transport Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十九年，天津海河溢，築堤守禦。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year of Qianlong the Hai River at Tianjin overflowed; he built dikes for defense.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong fifty-nine the Hai River at Tianjin burst its banks; he threw up dikes to hold the flood.

sentences.zh: 高宗以承志無守土責，能盡力，特詔嘉之。

translations.literal: Gaozong noted that Chengzhi had no territorial responsibility yet exerted himself fully and issued a special edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: The Gaozong Emperor saw that Chengzhi bore no territorial charge yet gave his full strength, and issued a special edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 尋病歸。

translations.literal: Soon he returned home on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He soon went home on sick leave.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶六年，從侍郎那彥寶治永定河，复授長蘆鹽運使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiaqing he followed Vice Minister Nayenbao in managing the Yongding River and was again appointed Changlu Salt Transport Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing six he assisted Vice Minister Nayenbao on the Yongding River and was again made Changlu Salt Transport Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七年，署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he served as acting Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he acted as Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy.

sentences.zh: 承志年已老，上特以其家世習河事，故任之。

translations.literal: Cheng Zhi was already old; the throne appointed him especially because his family had long practiced river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhi was by then elderly; the court gave him the post chiefly because his household had handled river works for generations.

sentences.zh: 八年，河決封丘衡家樓，次年，塞決工竣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the river broke at Hengjialou in Fengqiu; the next year the breach-closing works were finished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the river broke through at Hengjialou in Fengqiu; the following year the closure was complete.

sentences.zh: 召還京，授大理寺少卿。

translations.literal: He was recalled to the capital and appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Revision.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to the capital, he was made Vice Minister of the Court of Revision.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷順天府尹。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Prefect of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he became Prefect of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: He soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He died not long after.

sentences.zh: 康基田，字茂園，山西興縣人。

translations.literal: Kang Jitian, style name Maoyuan, was a native of Xing County, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Jitian, style name Maoyuan, came from Xing County in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年進士，授江蘇新陽知縣，調昭文。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the twenty-second year of Qianlong, he was appointed magistrate of Xinyang in Jiangsu and was transferred to Zhaowen.
translations.idiomatic: He took his jinshi in Qianlong twenty-two, became magistrate of Xinyang in Jiangsu, and was moved to Zhaowen.

sentences.zh: 為令幾十年，遷廣東潮州通判。

translations.literal: After nearly ten years as magistrate he was transferred to subprefect of Chaozhou in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate for nearly ten years, then was posted as subprefect of Chaozhou in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 以獲盜功，晉秩同知。

translations.literal: For capturing bandits he was promoted in rank to subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: Capturing bandits won him promotion to subprefect rank.

sentences.zh: 累遷河南河北道，調江南淮徐道，治河有聲。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Hebei Circuit in Henan, then to Huai-Xu Circuit in Jiangnan, and gained renown in river management.
translations.idiomatic: Promotions took him to Hebei Circuit in Henan and then Huai-Xu Circuit in Jiangnan, where his river work became well known.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，擢江蘇按察使。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year he was raised to Judicial Commissioner of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year he became Judicial Commissioner of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 命每年大汛赴淮、徐襄河務。

translations.literal: He was ordered each year during the great flood season to assist river affairs at Huai and Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Each great flood season he was ordered to assist river works on the Huai and Xu.

sentences.zh: 六月，河南睢州河溢，基田奉檄馳往堵築。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Suizhou River in Henan overflowed; Jitian rushed there on orders to close the breach.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Suizhou River in Henan broke; Jitian raced there under orders to seal it.

sentences.zh: 次年，遷江寧布政使，兼河務如故。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Financial Commissioner of Jiangning, still handling river affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he became Financial Commissioner of Jiangning while keeping his river duties.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，署江南河道總督，尋回任。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he acted as Governor of the Southern River Conservancy, then returned to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year he briefly served as Governor of the Southern River Conservancy, then resumed his former office.

sentences.zh: 六月，基田防汛睢南，值周家樓河溢，上游魏家莊大埽翻陷，基田壓焉，援救得生。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, while Jitian was on flood duty south of Suizhou, the Zhoujialou River overflowed; upstream the great revetment at Weijiazhuang collapsed and buried him, but rescue brought him out alive.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, while Jitian was fighting floods south of Suizhou, the Zhoujialou River burst; upstream the great revetment at Weijiazhuang overturned and trapped him, yet rescuers pulled him out alive.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其奮勉，特加恩賚。

translations.literal: An edict praised his zeal and granted special favors.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised his exertions and granted him special rewards.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，護理安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year he acted as Governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year he acted as Governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 以高郵糧胥偽造印串，巡撫閔鶚元被嚴譴，褫基田頂戴。

translations.literal: Because grain clerks at Gaoyou forged tally seals, Governor Min Eryuan was severely rebuked and Jitian was stripped of his peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaoyou grain clerks forged official tallies, Governor Min Eryuan was harshly punished and Jitian lost his peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 復以陳奏不實，革職逮問，遣戍伊犁。

translations.literal: He was again dismissed and arrested for false reporting, and was sent into exile at Yili.
translations.idiomatic: He was further dismissed and imprisoned for misreporting, then exiled to Yili.

sentences.zh: 尋許贖罪，以南河同知用。

translations.literal: Soon he was allowed to redeem his offense and was employed as Southern Rivers subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon permitted to redeem his sentence and was used as Southern Rivers subprefect.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，仍授淮徐道。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he was again appointed to Huai-Xu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year he returned to Huai-Xu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，力守豐汛曲家莊堤，特詔褒獎。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he stoutly held the Qujiazhuang dike during the Feng flood season and received a special edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year he held the Qujiazhuang levee through the Feng flood season and won a special commendation.

sentences.zh: 擢江蘇按察使，調山東，仍兼黃、運兩河事。

translations.literal: He was raised to Judicial Commissioner of Jiangsu, transferred to Shandong, and still handled both the Yellow and Grand Canal rivers.
translations.idiomatic: He became Judicial Commissioner of Jiangsu, was moved to Shandong, and still oversaw both the Yellow River and the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，南河豐汛河溢，基田赴工襄治，遷布政使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing the Feng flood on the Southern River overflowed; Jitian went to the works to assist and was promoted to Financial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing one the Feng-season river on the Southern Rivers broke; Jitian hurried to the site to help and was promoted to Financial Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命回山東，疏消漫水，撫卹災民，基田遂往來其間。

translations.literal: He was ordered back to Shandong to drain floodwater and comfort disaster victims; Jitian traveled back and forth between the two provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered back to Shandong to drain standing water and succor the afflicted, he shuttled between the two provinces.

sentences.zh: 次年春，豐工竣，賜花翎。

translations.literal: The next spring the Feng works were finished and he was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring the Feng project was done and he received the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 擢江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 秋，河溢碭山楊家壩，命馳視。

translations.literal: In autumn the river overflowed at Yangjiaba in Dangshan; he was ordered to inspect it at once.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the river broke at Yangjiaba in Dangshan; he was told to go at once.

sentences.zh: 山東曹縣河亦溢，復命往襄同堵築。

translations.literal: The Caoxian River in Shandong also overflowed; he was again ordered to assist in closing the breach.
translations.idiomatic: The Caoxian River in Shandong flooded as well; he was again sent to help seal the break.

sentences.zh: 授河東河道總督，尋調南河。

translations.literal: He was appointed Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy and soon transferred to the Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: He became Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy, then was shifted to the Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 三年，曹工合而復蟄，部議革職，詔寬免。

translations.literal: In the third year the Caozhou works closed and then failed again; the ministry recommended dismissal, but an edict granted leniency.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Caozhou closure held and then failed; the Board urged dismissal, but the throne was merciful.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「口門深逾十丈，擬就二壩前河勢灣處開引河，別築一壩，即以舊西壩改作挑水壩，俟秋後興工。」

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "The mouth is more than ten zhang deep; it is proposed to open a diversion channel at a bend in the river before the second dam, build another dam, and convert the old western dam into a deflector dam, with work to begin after autumn."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The breach mouth is now more than ten zhang deep. We propose to cut a diversion where the current bends before the second dam, erect a new dam, and turn the old western dam into a deflector—work to start after autumn."

sentences.zh: 詔責其延玩，褫翎頂。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked his delay and stripped his peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: The court blamed his procrastination and took his peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 尋命專任下游挑河事。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to devote himself solely to dredging works downstream.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to focus only on downstream dredging.

sentences.zh: 九月，河南睢州河复溢，水入渦、濉諸河，正河斷流。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Suizhou River in Henan overflowed again; water entered the Wo and Sui rivers and the main channel ran dry.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Suizhou River broke again; water poured into the Wo and Sui, and the main stream went dry.

sentences.zh: 大工旋合。

translations.literal: The major works were soon closed.
translations.idiomatic: The great closure was finished soon after.

sentences.zh: 次年春，睢工亦竣，河歸故道，引河通暢，复翎頂。

translations.literal: The next spring the Suizhou works were also finished, the river returned to its old course, the diversion ran clear, and his peacock feathers were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Next spring the Suizhou project too was complete: the river returned to its old bed, the diversion flowed freely, and his feathers were given back.

sentences.zh: 時有條奏治海口及復舊制混江龍者，基田疏言：「治河之法，首在束水攻沙。

translations.literal: At the time some submitted plans to manage the estuary and restore the old "Mixed River Dragon" device; Jitian memorialized: "The method of river control lies first in confining water to scour silt.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials then urged dredging the estuary and restoring the old Mixed River Dragon; Jitian replied: "River control begins with forcing the current to scour its own silt.

sentences.zh: 自曹工漫溢，溜或旁趨，遂致正河淤墊。

translations.literal: Since the Caozhou works overflowed, currents sometimes ran aside and the main channel silted up.
translations.idiomatic: After the Caozhou breach spread, currents often veered aside and the main channel filled in.

sentences.zh: 因上決而下淤，非先淤而後決。

translations.literal: Silting followed from breaches above, not breaches from silting below.
translations.idiomatic: Silt accumulated because breaks opened upstream—not breaks because silt had piled up first.

sentences.zh: 今睢工、曹工既竣，連年黃水漫衍，所在停沙，比至清江會淮，已成清水。

translations.literal: Now that Suizhou and Caozhou works are finished, the Yellow River has spread for years; wherever it paused it dropped silt, so that by the time it met the Huai at Qingjiang it had become clear water.
translations.idiomatic: With Suizhou and Caozhou done, years of Yellow River floods had spread and dropped silt wherever they lingered; by Qingjiang, where it joins the Huai, the water had cleared.

sentences.zh: 海口刷滌寬三百數十丈，毋庸疏濬。

translations.literal: The estuary had scoured itself to a width of more than three hundred zhang and needed no dredging.
translations.idiomatic: The mouth had scoured itself wider than three hundred zhang and required no digging.

sentences.zh: 混江龍助水之力甚微，不若束水攻沙、以水治水之力大而功倍。」

translations.literal: The Mixed River Dragon adds very little to the current's force; confining water to scour silt—using water to master water—achieves far more with less effort."
translations.idiomatic: The Mixed River Dragon adds little force to the stream; binding the current to scour silt—governing water with water—does far more with far less."

sentences.zh: 仁宗嘉納之。

translations.literal: The Jiaqing Emperor approved his view.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiaqing Emperor accepted his reasoning.

sentences.zh: 秋，河溢邵家壩。

translations.literal: In autumn the river overflowed at Shaojiaba.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the river broke at Shaojiaba.

sentences.zh: 十二月，堵合未旬日，壩复蟄，滲水，責基田賠帑。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the closure held less than ten days before the dam failed again and seeped; Jitian was ordered to pay indemnity silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the seal held less than ten days before the dam failed and seeped; Jitian was fined treasury silver.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，壩工失火，積料盡焚，革職，留工效力。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year a fire destroyed stored materials; he was dismissed but kept on the works to serve.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, first month, fire burned all stockpiled materials; he was dismissed but left to labor on the project.

sentences.zh: 基田馭下素嚴，督率將卒守堤，動以軍法從事，稽延者杖枷不貸，人多怨之。

translations.literal: Jitian had always been strict with subordinates; he led officers and soldiers to guard the dikes and routinely applied military law, beating and cangueing delayers without mercy, and many resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Jitian ran a tight ship: he drove officers and troops onto the levees and enforced military discipline without mercy—delays brought the rod or the cangue—and many bore him a grudge.

sentences.zh: 又官吏積弊懼揭，陰縱火以掩其跡。

translations.literal: Moreover, officials long accustomed to abuses feared exposure and secretly set fires to cover their tracks.
translations.idiomatic: Officials steeped in old corruption feared being exposed and quietly set fires to hide what they had done.

sentences.zh: 帝亦知基田性剛守潔，惟責其苛細，仍命隨辦要工，欲復用之。

translations.literal: The Emperor also knew Jitian was stern and incorruptible and blamed only his harshness; he still ordered him to handle urgent works, intending to employ him again.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor knew Jitian was rigid and honest, faulted only his severity, and still set him on critical projects with an eye to bringing him back.

sentences.zh: 及邵家壩工竣，以知州用，補江蘇太倉直隸州。

translations.literal: When the Shaojiaba works were finished he was used at prefect rank and appointed to Taicang Direct Prefecture in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: After Shaojiaba was closed he was restored at prefect rank and posted to Taicang Direct Prefecture in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 逾年，擢廣東布政使，調江西，又調江寧。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was raised to Financial Commissioner of Guangdong, transferred to Jiangxi, and then to Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he became Financial Commissioner of Guangdong, then Jiangxi, then Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 十一年，因貴州鉛船遲滯，降調，授戶部郎中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, because Guizhou lead-transport boats were delayed, he was demoted and appointed a director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year delays in Guizhou lead convoys brought a demotion; he was made a director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十三年，從協辦大學士長麟、戴衢亨察視南河，基田請修復天然閘迤東十八里屯二石閘，靳輔所建也，足以減黃濟運，且山石夾峙，無奪溜衝決之患，據以入告。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he accompanied Associate Grand Secretary Chang Lin and Dai Yuheng in inspecting the Southern Rivers; Jitian asked to restore the two stone sluices at Shibalicun east of the Natural Sluice, built by Jin Fu, which could reduce Yellow River water to aid transport and were flanked by mountains and rocks without risk of diverted currents or sudden breaks, and memorialized accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he joined Associate Grand Secretaries Chang Lin and Dai Yuheng on an inspection of the Southern Rivers. Jitian urged restoring the twin stone gates at Shibalicun east of the Natural Sluice—Jin Fu's work—which could bleed off Yellow River flow for the grain transport and sat between rock walls safe from rogue currents; he laid this out in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其留心河務，加道銜，賜花翎。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his attention to river affairs, added a circuit intendant rank, and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: The throne commended his grasp of river work, gave him circuit-intendant rank, and awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 尋予太僕寺少卿職銜，稽核南河要工錢糧。

translations.literal: Soon he was given the nominal rank of Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud and was charged with auditing funds and grain for key Southern River works.
translations.idiomatic: He soon received the nominal title of Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud and audited money and grain for major Southern River projects.

sentences.zh: 十六年，以年逾八旬，乞休，允之，命來京就養，以示優恤。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, having passed eighty, he begged to retire; permission was granted and he was ordered to come to the capital for support, as a mark of favor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, past eighty, he asked to retire. The court agreed and summoned him to the capital for maintenance—a mark of special regard.

sentences.zh: 後議改建山盱五壩，特命與議。

translations.literal: Later, when rebuilding the five dams at Shanxu was discussed, he was specially ordered to take part in deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: When plans arose to rebuild the five Shanxu dams, he was specially called in to advise.

sentences.zh: 基田疏陳：「舊制盡善，不宜輕改。

translations.literal: Jitian memorialized: "The old system was entirely sound and should not be lightly altered.
translations.idiomatic: Jitian wrote: "The old arrangement was sound and ought not be changed lightly.

sentences.zh: 今仁、義、禮三壩石底損壞，跌成深塘，不得已為變通之計。

translations.literal: Now the stone foundations of the Ren, Yi, and Li dams are damaged and have fallen into deep pools; only then is expedient change unavoidable.
translations.idiomatic: Today the stone beds of the Ren, Yi, and Li dams are broken and have scooped out deep pits—only then is a stopgap justified.

sentences.zh: 請將仁、義二壩先改其一，俟大汛果見順利，再議添所建。

translations.literal: I ask that one of the Ren and Yi dams be altered first; after the great flood season proves successful, we may discuss adding what is to be built.
translations.idiomatic: Let us alter one of the Ren and Yi dams first; if the high-water season goes well, we can decide what more to build.

sentences.zh: 擬禮壩先築草壩，非湖水大漲，不可輕放。」

translations.literal: For the Li dam I propose building a grass dam first; unless lake water rises greatly, it must not be opened lightly."
translations.idiomatic: For the Li dam I would start with a grass barrier and open it only when the lake truly surges."

sentences.zh: 奏入，報聞。

translations.literal: The memorial was received and noted.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went in and was acknowledged.

sentences.zh: 十八年，鄉舉重逢，賜三品卿銜，與鹿鳴宴。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, on the provincial examination reunion, he was granted third-rank minister rank and attended the Lu-Ming banquet.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, at the jubilee of his jinshi year, he received third-rank minister rank and joined the Lu-Ming feast.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: He soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He died not long after.

sentences.zh: 吳璥，字式如，浙江錢塘人，吏部侍郎嗣爵子。

translations.literal: Wu Jing, style name Shiru, was a native of Qiantang, Zhejiang, son of Vice Minister of Personnel Sijue.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jing, style name Shiru, came from Qiantang in Zhejiang; his father was Vice Minister of Personnel Sijue.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十三年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the forty-third year of Qianlong, he was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He took his jinshi in Qianlong forty-three, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and became a compiler.

sentences.zh: 大考擢侍講學士，典陝西鄉試。

translations.literal: In the palace examination he was raised to expositor of the Hanlin Academy and served as provincial examiner for Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: A strong showing in the palace exam made him an expositor of the Hanlin, and he ran the Shaanxi provincial examinations.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，督安徽學政。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he supervised education in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year he was Education Commissioner of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 召見，高宗因其父曾為總河，詢以河務，所對稱旨，即日授河南開歸陳許道。

translations.literal: On audience, Gaozong, because his father had once been Director-General of Rivers, questioned him on river affairs; his answers pleased the Emperor and that same day he was appointed to the Kaifeng Circuit in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: At court Gaozong, knowing his father had headed river works, tested him on hydraulics. His answers satisfied the Emperor, and the same day he received the Kaifeng Circuit in Henan.

sentences.zh: 累遷布政使。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Financial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to Financial Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，巡撫出視賑，璥充鄉試監臨，聞河水暴漲，即出闈馳防，帝嘉之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year, while the governor was away on relief inspection, Jing served as provincial examination supervisor; hearing that the river had risen sharply, he left the examination hall at once to rush to flood defense, and the Emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year, with the governor away on famine duty, Jing supervised the provincial exams. Hearing the river had surged, he left the hall immediately for the levees, and the Emperor commended him.

sentences.zh: 六十年，署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he acted as governor.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，楚匪齊王氏犯河南，擊走之，复剿息縣匪，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing, Chu bandits under Qi Wangshi invaded Henan; he drove them off, then again suppressed bandits at Xixian and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing two, Chu rebels under Qi Wangshi struck Henan; he beat them back, then crushed bandits at Xixian and won the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 母憂留任。

translations.literal: During mourning for his mother he was kept at his post.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he was kept in office despite mourning.

sentences.zh: 四年，署河東河道總督，尋實授。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he acted as Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy and soon received the substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he acted as Eastern River governor, then received the full appointment.

sentences.zh: 請增河工料價，歸地糧攤徵，詔斥其病民，革職留任。

translations.literal: He asked to raise prices for river materials and spread the cost through land tax; an edict rebuked this as harmful to the people and dismissed him from rank while keeping him at his post.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed higher material prices charged to the land tax; the throne called this a burden on the people, stripped his rank, and left him in place.

sentences.zh: 五年，調南河，堵合邵家壩漫口，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to the Southern Rivers, closed the overflow at Shaojiaba, and was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he moved to the Southern Rivers, sealed Shaojiaba, and became Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 八年秋，河決衡家樓，命豫籌來年漕運，請疏邳州、宿遷諸閘，於宿遷、桃源交界築束水草壩，濬淤淺，依議行。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eighth year the river broke at Hengjialou; he was ordered to plan next year's grain transport in advance and asked to dredge sluices at Pizhou and Suqian, build a grass dam to confine water at the Suqian-Taoyuan border, and clear shoals; the plan was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn of the eighth year brought a break at Hengjialou. Ordered to prepare the next grain fleet, he sought dredging at Pizhou and Suqian, a binding grass dam on the Suqian-Taoyuan line, and shoal clearance—the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 又言徐州一帶河水寬深而未消落，乃海口壅塞所致，詔相度治之。

translations.literal: He also stated that in the Xuzhou region the river was wide and deep yet had not fallen, caused by blockage at the estuary, and an edict ordered survey and remedy.
translations.idiomatic: He argued that around Xuzhou the river stayed wide and deep because the estuary was choked, and the court ordered a survey.

sentences.zh: 尋疏陳：「雲梯關海口暗灘，尚非全被阻遏。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized: "At the Yuntiguan estuary hidden shoals are not yet wholly obstructing flow.
translations.idiomatic: He soon wrote: "Hidden bars at the Yuntiguan mouth do not yet fully block the current.

sentences.zh: 請於黃泥嘴開引河，並挑吉家浦、於家港、倪家灘、宋家尖諸灘。」

translations.literal: I ask to open a diversion at Huangnizui and dredge the bars at Jijiapu, Yujiagang, Nijiatan, and Songjiajian."
translations.idiomatic: Cut a diversion at Huangnizui and dredge Jijiapu, Yujiagang, Nijiatan, and Songjiajian."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 九年秋，洪湖水漲未消，請緩築仁、智兩壩，以保堰、盱堤工。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the ninth year Hongze Lake had not yet subsided; he asked to delay rebuilding the Ren and Zhi dams to protect works on the Yan and Xu dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth-year autumn Hongze had not fallen; he asked to postpone the Ren and Zhi dams to protect the Yan and Xu levees.

sentences.zh: 時東河衡工甫合，清江浦河口水淺阻糧船，上謂清水力弱，由啟放仁、智等壩所致，命侍郎姜晟往會籌蓄黃濟運。

translations.literal: At the time the Eastern River Hengjialou works had just closed; at Qingjiangpu the estuary was shallow and blocked grain boats; the throne held that clear water was too weak because the Ren, Zhi, and other dams had been opened, and ordered Vice Minister Jiang Sheng to join in planning how to store Yellow River water to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: Hengjialou had just been sealed, yet Qingjiangpu was too shallow for grain boats. The court blamed weak clear water on opening the Ren and Zhi dams and sent Vice Minister Jiang Sheng to plan storing Yellow River flow for transport.

sentences.zh: 璥與合疏請堵二壩及惠濟閘之鉗口壩，使湖水全力東注，刷通河口，並啟李工口門，減掣黃水，從之。

translations.literal: Jing jointly memorialized to block the two dams and the pinch dam at the Huiji Sluice so lake water would pour east with full force to scour the estuary, and also to open the Li works mouth to ease Yellow River water; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Jing and Jiang jointly urged blocking the two dams and the Huiji pinch dam so lake water could scour the mouth, and opening the Li breach to bleed Yellow River water—the plan was adopted.

sentences.zh: 上終以璥多病，治河不力，雖宥其罪，命解職。

translations.literal: The Emperor finally held that Jing was often ill and ineffective in river management; though his offenses were pardoned, he was ordered to resign.
translations.idiomatic: In the end the Emperor judged Jing too sick and too weak on the rivers; though forgiven, he was told to step down.

sentences.zh: 十年，授兵部侍郎，調倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed Vice Minister of War and transferred to Vice Minister of the Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he became Vice Minister of War, then Vice Minister of Grain Transport.

sentences.zh: 十一年，复授河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was again appointed Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he returned as Eastern River governor.

sentences.zh: 因料物例價不敷，請依南河按時價折銷，允之。

translations.literal: Because standard material prices were insufficient, he asked to write off costs at current prices as on the Southern Rivers; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Standard prices could not cover materials; he sought Southern Rivers-style write-offs at market rates, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 復請歲料幫價歸地糧攤徵，被嚴斥，革職留任。

translations.literal: He again asked to spread supplemental annual material costs through land tax; he was severely rebuked and dismissed from rank while kept at his post.
translations.idiomatic: He again wanted supplemental costs on the land tax, was sharply rebuked, and lost rank while staying on the job.

sentences.zh: 尋又以堤堰工需併入衡工善後題銷，上切責之。

translations.literal: Soon he also sought to fold dike and dam needs into Hengjialou aftermath accounts; the Emperor sternly rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: He then tried to charge levee work to Hengjialou cleanup accounts and drew a sharp rebuke.

sentences.zh: 十三年，召回京，授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was recalled to the capital and appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was recalled and made Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 命偕侍郎托津赴江蘇鞫獄，並勘議海口改道，請仍復故道，接築雲梯關外大堤，從之。

translations.literal: He was ordered with Vice Minister Tuojin to try cases in Jiangsu and survey changing the estuary course; he asked to restore the old channel, continue the great dike outside Yuntiguan, and approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: With Vice Minister Tuojin he was sent to Jiangsu for trials and to study shifting the estuary; he urged the old course and extending the great dike beyond Yuntiguan—the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 复授江南河道總督。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Governor of the Southern River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made Southern River governor.

sentences.zh: 十四年，疏陳：「海口應濬，而大堤不堅，旁洩必淤；

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he memorialized: "The estuary should be dredged, but if the great dike is not solid, side leaks will surely silt it up again;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he wrote: "The mouth must be dredged, yet a weak great dike will leak and silt up again;

sentences.zh: 蓄清為要，而堤壩不復，遇漲必潰。

translations.literal: storing clear water is essential, yet if dikes and dams are not restored, every rise will burst;
translations.idiomatic: holding clear water matters, but without restored levees and dams every flood will burst through;

sentences.zh: 今閘壩無減黃之路，五壩無節宣之方，皆宜急為救治。」

translations.literal: now sluices offer no path to reduce Yellow River water, and the five dams have no way to regulate discharge—all need urgent remedy."
translations.idiomatic: today the gates cannot bleed the Yellow River and the five dams cannot regulate flow—all demand urgent repair."

sentences.zh: 詔韙之，令盡心經理。

translations.literal: An edict approved his view and ordered him to manage affairs with full devotion.
translations.idiomatic: The throne endorsed his view and told him to give the work his full care.

sentences.zh: 是冬，以海口挑復正河，費用浩繁，不及於次年桃汛前舉工，請權宜仍濬北潮河以通去路。

translations.literal: That winter, because dredging the estuary to restore the main channel would be hugely expensive and could not be finished before the next peach-blossom flood season, he asked as an expedient to dredge the Beichao River again for an outlet.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, restoring the main channel through the mouth would cost too much to finish before the spring flood; he asked to reopen the Beichao River as a temporary outlet.

sentences.zh: 十五年春，偕兩江總督松筠合疏請修復正河，詔允行；

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year he jointly memorialized with Liangjiang Governor-General Songyun to restore the main channel; an edict approved;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth-year spring he and Governor-General Songyun jointly urged restoring the main channel, and the court approved;

sentences.zh: 而斥璥無定見，前後矛盾，責其認真督治，不得以事由松筠主持為推諉之地。

translations.literal: but rebuked Jing for lack of fixed judgment and self-contradiction, ordering him to supervise earnestly and not use Songyun's lead as an excuse to shirk.
translations.idiomatic: yet rebuked Jing for wavering and contradiction, telling him to supervise in earnest and not hide behind Songyun.

sentences.zh: 尋因病乞假，詔解職，俟病痊以六部尚書用。

translations.literal: Soon he begged leave on account of illness; an edict relieved him of office and ordered that after recovery he be used as a minister of one of the Six Boards.
translations.idiomatic: He soon fell ill and asked leave; the court removed him but promised a Six Ministries post when he recovered.

sentences.zh: 璥既去任，松筠疏論河工積弊，謂璥與徐端治理失宜，用人不當，墊款九十餘萬，恐有冒捏。

translations.literal: After Jing left office, Songyun memorialized on accumulated abuses in river works, stating that Jing and Xu Duan had governed poorly, employed the wrong men, and left advances of more than nine hundred thousand taels, fearing fabrication.
translations.idiomatic: After Jing left, Songyun attacked river corruption, blaming Jing and Xu Duan for bad management, bad hires, and more than nine hundred thousand taels in advances that might be fictitious.

sentences.zh: 又兩淮鹽政阿克當阿劾揚河通判繆元淳浮冒工款，稱：「璥路過揚州，與言廳員營弁不肖者多，往往虛報工程，且有無工借支。

translations.literal: The Liang-Huai salt commissioner Akedanga also impeached Yangzhou River Vice Prefect Miao Yuanchun for padded works funds, stating: "When Jing passed through Yangzhou he said many bureau clerks and camp officers were unworthy and often reported false projects, and some drew advances with no work at all.
translations.idiomatic: Salt commissioner Akedanga impeached Yangzhou vice prefect Miao Yuanchun for inflated projects, noting: "When Jing passed Yangzhou he said many clerks and officers were crooked, filed false works, and sometimes took advances for nothing.

sentences.zh: 前在任六七年，用帑一千餘萬，今此數年，竟至三四千萬。」

translations.literal: In his six or seven years in office he used more than ten million taels of treasury funds; in just these few years it has reached thirty or forty million."
translations.idiomatic: In six or seven years he spent over ten million taels; in only a few years since, the figure has hit thirty or forty million."

sentences.zh: 詔斥璥知而不奏，命尚書托津等往南河按之，劾璥失察誤工；

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Jing for knowing yet not reporting and ordered Minister Tuojin and others to investigate on the Southern Rivers; Jing was impeached for failure of oversight and faulty works;
translations.idiomatic: The throne rebuked Jing for silence and sent Minister Tuojin south; Jing was faulted for lax oversight and botched projects;

sentences.zh: 又濬淮北鹽河，未經奏陳，濬後復淤，詔切責，降四級調用，與徐端分賠鹽河工款，命璥赴南河襄辦王營減壩及李家樓漫口。

translations.literal: he had also dredged the Huai-Bei salt canal without memorializing; after dredging it silted again; an edict sharply rebuked him, demoted him four grades for reassignment, and ordered Jing and Xu Duan to share indemnity for the salt canal works, directing Jing to assist on the Southern Rivers at the Wangying reduction dam and the Lijialou overflow.
translations.idiomatic: He had dredged the Huai-Bei salt canal without reporting; it silted shut again. Rebuked and demoted four grades, he and Xu Duan were ordered to share salt-canal costs while Jing assisted on the Wangying reduction dam and Lijialou breach.

sentences.zh: 十七年，補光祿寺卿，累遷吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and was promoted repeatedly to Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he became Director of Imperial Entertainments and rose to Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十八年，睢州河溢，命赴南河察勘湖河。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Suizhou River overflowed; he was ordered to go to the Southern Rivers to survey lakes and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the Suizhou River broke; he was sent south to survey lakes and rivers.

sentences.zh: 十九年，授河東河道總督，督治睢工。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was appointed Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy to supervise Suizhou works.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he became Eastern River governor to oversee Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 次年，遷兵部尚書，工竣回京，歷刑部、吏部，協辦大學士。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Minister of War; when the works were finished he returned to the capital, served in Punishments and Personnel, and became Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he became Minister of War; when the project ended he returned, served in Punishments and Personnel, and became Associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 上以璥練習河務，無歲不奉使出勘河。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Jing was skilled in river affairs, sent him out every year to survey rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing Jing's river expertise, the Emperor dispatched him almost yearly to inspect waterways.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，協防東河秋汛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he assisted in autumn flood defense on the Eastern River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he helped with autumn flood work on the Eastern River.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，勘睢工及山東運河，南河蕭南民堰，清江浦禦黃、束清諸壩。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he surveyed Suizhou works and the Shandong Grand Canal, the Minyan dike south of the Xiao River on the Southern Rivers, and the Yellow River-control and Shuqing dams at Qingjiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he inspected Suizhou, the Shandong canal, the Minyan dike on the Southern Rivers, and Qingjiangpu's Yellow-control and Shuqing dams.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，築沁河漫口。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he closed the Qin River overflow.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he sealed the Qin River breach.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，築河南蘭陽、儀封及武涉馬營壩決口。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he closed breaches at Lanyang and Yifeng in Henan and at the Maying dam in Wu-She.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he closed breaks at Lanyang and Yifeng in Henan and at Maying in Wu-She.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，勘南河束清、禦黃諸壩及洩水事宜。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he surveyed the Shuqing and Yellow-control dams on the Southern Rivers and matters of flood discharge.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he reviewed the Shuqing and Yellow-control dams and flood-release plans on the Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 其間再署河南巡撫，一署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the interval he twice acted as Governor of Henan and once as Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: Between times he twice acted as Henan governor and once as Eastern River governor.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，以病免。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he was excused on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang one he retired for illness.

sentences.zh: 二年，因侍郎那彥寶治河不職降黜，追論璥與同罪，雖已致仕家居，褫其翎頂。

translations.literal: In the second year, because Vice Minister Nayenbao was demoted for incompetence in river management, Jing was retrospectively judged guilty of the same offense; though already retired at home, his peacock feathers were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang two, Nayenbao's demotion for river failure brought a retroactive judgment against Jing; though retired, he lost his peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: He soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He died not long after.

sentences.zh: 徐端，字肇之，浙江德清人。

translations.literal: Xu Duan, style name Zhaozhi, was a native of Deqing, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Duan, style name Zhaozhi, came from Deqing in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 父振甲，官江蘇清河知縣。

translations.literal: His father Zhenjia served as magistrate of Qinghe in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhenjia had been magistrate of Qinghe in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 端少隨任，習於河事。

translations.literal: As a youth Duan followed his father on assignment and became versed in river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Duan grew up on his father's postings and learned river work early.

sentences.zh: 入貲為通判。

translations.literal: He purchased office as a subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: He bought his way into a subprefect post.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，河決青龍岡。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign the river broke at Qinglonggang.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong the river broke at Qinglonggang.

sentences.zh: 振甲知涉縣，分挑引河，端佐役，大學士阿桂督工，見而器之，留東河任用，授蘭儀通判。

translations.literal: Zhenjia was magistrate of She County and supervised dredging a diversion; Duan assisted on the works; Grand Secretary Agui directed the project, took a liking to him, retained him for Eastern River service, and appointed him subprefect of Lanyi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenjia, as magistrate of She County, oversaw a diversion; Duan helped on site. Grand Secretary Agui, directing the work, took notice, kept him on the Eastern River, and made him subprefect of Lanyi.

sentences.zh: 尋升缺為同知，調睢寧，又調開封下南河。

translations.literal: Soon his vacancy was filled as subprefect; he was transferred to Suining and then to the Lower Southern River at Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He soon rose from acting subprefect to Suining, then to the Lower Southern River at Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，署山東沂曹道。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing he acted as Yicao Circuit Intendant in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing three he acted as Yicao intendant in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 睢州河決，端預築曹州堤，得無害。

translations.literal: When the Suizhou River broke, Duan had already built the Caozhou dike beforehand and escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: When Suizhou broke, Duan had already strengthened the Caozhou levee and kept damage at bay.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢江西饒州知府，未之任，調江蘇淮安。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to prefect of Raozhou in Jiangxi but did not take up the post and was transferred to Huai'an in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was named prefect of Raozhou in Jiangxi but was shifted to Huai'an in Jiangsu before taking office.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢淮徐道，丁父憂，與假治喪，仍回任。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was raised to Huai-Xu Circuit Intendant; on his father's death he was granted mourning leave with permission to return after the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became Huai-Xu intendant; when his father died he mourned but was allowed back afterward.

sentences.zh: 九年，加三品頂戴，護理東河河道總督。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was given third-rank peacock feathers and acted as Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he received third-rank peacock feathers and acted as Eastern River governor.

sentences.zh: 時衡家樓甫塞決，詔以前官王秉韜惜費，嵇承志年衰，修防多疏，責端通籌全河為未雨綢繆之計。

translations.literal: At the time Hengjialou had just been closed; an edict noted that former official Wang Bingtao had been too frugal, Ji Chengzhi too old, and repairs too lax, and charged Duan to plan comprehensively for the whole river as a precaution.
translations.idiomatic: Hengjialou had just closed. The court said Wang Bingtao had scrimped, Ji Chengzhi had aged, and upkeep had slipped, and told Duan to plan the whole river ahead of disaster.

sentences.zh: 端疏陳臨河埽工固緊要，無工之地尤須慎防，仁宗韙之。

translations.literal: Duan memorialized that revetments along the river were urgent, but places without works especially needed vigilance; the Jiaqing Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: Duan wrote that revetments on the channel were critical, but empty stretches needed even more watchfulness; the Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 冬，清口水淺阻漕船，端偕尚書姜晟等往視，請展引河，啟祥符五瑞壩，分河水入洪湖助清敵黃，清口乃通。

translations.literal: In winter the Qingkou estuary was shallow and blocked grain boats; Duan joined Minister Jiang Sheng and others on inspection and asked to extend the diversion, open the Xiangfu Wurui dam, and split water into Hongze Lake to strengthen clear water against the Yellow River; Qingkou then cleared.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Qingkou shoaled and blocked grain boats. With Jiang Sheng and others he inspected, urged a longer diversion, opening the Xiangfu Wurui dam to feed Hongze and stiffen clear water against the Yellow River—and Qingkou opened.

sentences.zh: 尋授江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor of the Southern River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became Southern River governor.

sentences.zh: 十年，請疏治雲梯關沙淤，培築桃源以下堤工；

translations.literal: In the tenth year he asked to dredge silt at Yuntiguan and build dikes below Taoyuan;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he sought dredging at Yuntiguan and levees below Taoyuan;

sentences.zh: 又請移建河口束清壩於迤南湖水匯出之處，以資節制；

translations.literal: he also asked to move the Shuqing dam at the estuary south to where lake water converged for better control;
translations.idiomatic: he also proposed moving the Shuqing dam south to the lake outfall for better control;

sentences.zh: 挑清壩外築束清東壩，對岸張家莊增築西壩，留口門二十丈，視湖水大小為束展：詔允行。

translations.literal: dredge outside Qing dam and build an eastern Shuqing dam, add a western dam at Zhangjiazhuang, and leave a twenty-zhang mouth to open or close according to lake level: approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: dredge beyond the Qing barrier, build an eastern Shuqing dam, add a western dam at Zhangjiazhuang, and leave a twenty-zhang opening sized to the lake—approved.

sentences.zh: 秋，築義壩。

translations.literal: In autumn he built the Yi dam.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he built the Yi dam.

sentences.zh: 時命侍郎戴均元會籌蓄黃濟運，端與合疏請濬王營減壩以下鹽河，遇盛漲，相機啟放，庶黃減淮強，湖水暢出，堰工亦免著重，從之。

translations.literal: At the time Vice Minister Dai Junyuan was ordered to plan storing Yellow River water for transport; Duan jointly memorialized to dredge the salt canal below the Wangying reduction dam and, during great floods, to open it as needed so the Yellow River would ease, the Huai strengthen, lake water flow freely, and dam works bear less strain; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Dai Junyuan was then planning Yellow River storage for transport. Duan joined him to dredge the salt canal below Wangying and open it in high floods so the Yellow River eased, the Huai strengthened, the lake drained, and the dams took less strain—the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 十一年，洪湖異漲，高堰賴新築子堰抵禦，不為害。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Hongze rose extraordinarily; the Gaoyan weir was saved by a newly built subsidiary weir and suffered no harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Hongze surged abnormally; a new child weir at Gaoyan held and spared the main works.

sentences.zh: 俄黃水並漲，決鹽河民堰，運河東岸荷花塘亦決。

translations.literal: Soon Yellow River water rose together; the salt canal Minyan dike broke, and the lotus pond on the east bank of the Grand Canal also broke.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Yellow River rose together with it; the salt canal Minyan dike failed, and the lotus pond on the canal's east bank broke as well.

sentences.zh: 以功過相抵，免議。

translations.literal: Merit and fault offset each other and no censure was proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Credit and blame cancelled out, and no penalty followed.

sentences.zh: 舊制，南河設正副總河，後裁其副；

translations.literal: Under the old system the Southern River had principal and deputy Directors-General; the deputy was later abolished;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Southern Rivers had principal and deputy directors-general; the deputy post was later cut;

sentences.zh: 至是授戴均元為河道總督，端副之。

translations.literal: At this point Dai Junyuan was appointed Director-General of Rivers and Duan served as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Junyuan was now made river director-general, with Duan as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 秋，河決周家樓，上游郭家房堤蟄，命端專治郭家房堵口，四閱月工竣。

translations.literal: In autumn the river broke at Zhoujialou; upstream the Guojiafang dike failed; Duan was ordered to focus on closing Guojiafang; after four months the works were finished.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the river broke at Zhoujialou and the Guojiafang levee failed upstream. Duan was told to seal Guojiafang alone; four months later the job was done.

sentences.zh: 時黃水由減壩六塘河入海，正河斷流，群議改道，上頒示御製黃河改道記，命端視察海口。

translations.literal: At the time Yellow River water entered the sea through the Liutang River via the reduction dam; the main channel ran dry; many debated changing the course; the throne issued an imperial composition on changing the Yellow River course and ordered Duan to survey the estuary.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow River water then reached the sea through the reduction dam and Liutang River while the main bed went dry. Debate turned to shifting the course; the Emperor issued his essay on changing the Yellow River and ordered Duan to inspect the mouth.

sentences.zh: 尋以六塘河下游水勢散漫，難施工作，复頒示御製治舊河記，命端專駐減壩督工。

translations.literal: Soon, because downstream of Liutang River the current was too scattered for work, the throne again issued an imperial composition on managing the old river and ordered Duan to remain at the reduction dam to supervise works.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Liutang lower course proved too scattered to work. The Emperor reissued his essay on the old river and told Duan to stay at the reduction dam and supervise.

sentences.zh: 十二年春，工竣，河循故道，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twelfth year the works were finished and the river followed its old course; he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth-year spring the project finished and the river returned to its old bed; he became Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 秋，海潮上漾，河由陳家浦旁溢入射陽湖歸海，請於黃泥嘴建壩，擇要疏淤，俾仍故道。

translations.literal: In autumn sea tides rose; the river overflowed beside Chenjiapu into Sheyang Lake and reached the sea; he asked to build a dam at Huangnizui and dredge key shoals so it would return to the old course.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn tides pushed the river aside at Chenjiapu into Sheyang Lake to the sea. He proposed a dam at Huangnizui and selective dredging to restore the old route.

sentences.zh: 十三年，署正總河。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he acted as principal Director-General.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he acted as principal director-general.

sentences.zh: 先是端屢言河淤由於海口流緩，宜接築雲梯關外長堤，束水攻沙，未及舉。

translations.literal: Earlier Duan had repeatedly said silting came from a slow estuary current and that a long dike outside Yuntiguan should be built to confine water and scour silt, but it had not yet been undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: Duan had long argued that silting came from a sluggish mouth and urged a long levee beyond Yuntiguan to confine the current and scour silt, but the work had not started.

sentences.zh: 至是兩江總督鐵保疏申前議，並請培高堰土坡，修補智、禮二壩，以備湖漲；

translations.literal: Now Liangjiang Governor-General Tiebao memorialized again for the earlier plan and asked to raise the Gaoyan earthen slope and repair the Zhi and Li dams against lake floods;
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Tiebao now revived the plan and asked to heighten the Gaoyan slope and repair the Zhi and Li dams against lake surges;

sentences.zh: 复毛城鋪石堤、王營減壩，以節宣黃水：端贊其議。

translations.literal: restore the Maocheng stone dike and the Wangying reduction dam to regulate Yellow River water: Duan endorsed the plan.
translations.idiomatic: restore the Maocheng stone levee and Wangying reduction dam to regulate Yellow River flow—Duan backed it.

sentences.zh: 命協辦大學士長麟、戴衢亨察視，惟輟毛城鋪壩工，改建徐州十八里屯雙閘，餘依原議行。

translations.literal: Associate Grand Secretaries Chang Lin and Dai Yuheng were ordered to inspect; only the Maocheng dam works were halted and twin sluices were built at Shibalicun in Xuzhou instead; the rest proceeded as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Lin and Dai Yuheng were sent to inspect. Only the Maocheng dam was dropped in favor of twin gates at Xuzhou Shibalicun; the rest went ahead.

sentences.zh: 夏，湖水漲，端啟智、信二壩，不敷宣洩，壞磚工百餘丈，褫翎頂，降三級留任。

translations.literal: In summer lake water rose; Duan opened the Zhi and Xin dams but discharge was insufficient; more than a hundred zhang of brick works were destroyed; his peacock feathers were stripped and he was demoted three grades while kept at his post.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he opened the Zhi and Xin dams, but release was inadequate and over a hundred zhang of brickwork failed. He lost his feathers, was demoted three ranks, and stayed on.

sentences.zh: 尋堵合，復之。

translations.literal: Soon the breach was closed and his rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The break was soon sealed and his rank restored.

sentences.zh: 時黃水由馬港口分流，經灌河口歸海，命尚書吳璥、侍郎托津會勘，以荷花塘壩工垂成復蟄，降端為副總河。

translations.literal: At the time Yellow River water split at Magangkou and reached the sea through the Guanhekou; Ministers Wu Jing and Tuojin were ordered to survey jointly; because the lotus pond dam works were nearly finished but failed again, Duan was demoted to deputy director-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow River water then split at Magang and exited through Guanhekou. Ministers Wu Jing and Tuojin surveyed together; when the lotus-pond dam nearly held and failed again, Duan was demoted to deputy director-general.

sentences.zh: 十五年，复授河道總督，裁副總河。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was again appointed Director-General of Rivers and the deputy post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he returned as director-general and the deputy post was cut.

sentences.zh: 端始終主復舊海口堵馬港，命尚書馬慧裕會同督治。

translations.literal: Duan consistently urged restoring the old estuary and blocking Magang; Minister Ma Huiyu was ordered to supervise jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Duan kept pressing the old mouth and blocking Magang; Minister Ma Huiyu was ordered to join him.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督松筠劾端於河流逢灣取直，以致停淤，上不直其奏，端疏辨，詔松筠無預河務，責端與慧裕速施工，勿游移。

translations.literal: Liangjiang Governor-General Songyun impeached Duan for straightening bends and causing silting; the throne did not uphold the memorial; Duan memorialized in defense; an edict told Songyun to keep out of river affairs and ordered Duan and Huiyu to hurry the works without wavering.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun accused Duan of cutting bends straight and causing silt. The court sided with Duan; Songyun was told to stay out of river affairs while Duan and Huiyu were ordered to push the work without delay.

sentences.zh: 尋以洪湖風汛，壞高堰、山盱兩廳工甚鉅，革職留任。

translations.literal: Soon Hongze wind floods destroyed major works at the Gaoyan and Shanxu bureaus; he was dismissed from rank but kept at his post.
translations.idiomatic: A Hongze wind flood then wrecked major Gaoyan and Shanxu projects; he lost rank but remained on the job.

sentences.zh: 松筠复密陳端祗知工程，不曉機宜，糜帑千萬，迄無成功，且恐有浮冒之弊。

translations.literal: Songyun again secretly memorialized that Duan knew only construction, not strategy, had wasted ten million taels without success, and might be padding accounts.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun secretly wrote again that Duan knew engineering but not policy, had spent ten million taels without success, and might be padding accounts.

sentences.zh: 詔斥端不胜河督之任，革職留工，專任堵築義壩。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Duan as unfit for the river post, dismissed him from rank but kept him on the works, and assigned him solely to close the Yi dam.
translations.idiomatic: The court said Duan was unfit to head the rivers, stripped his rank, kept him on site, and limited him to closing the Yi dam.

sentences.zh: 十六年，命以通判用，復命治李家樓引河。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was ordered used as a subprefect and again assigned to manage the Lijialou diversion.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was reduced to subprefect use and again put on the Lijialou diversion.

sentences.zh: 十七年，工甫竣，病卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, just as the works were finished, he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the work had just finished when illness killed him.

sentences.zh: 端治南河七年，熟諳工作。

translations.literal: Duan managed the Southern Rivers for seven years and was thoroughly versed in the work.
translations.idiomatic: For seven years Duan ran the Southern Rivers and knew the work inside out.

sentences.zh: 葦柳積堤，一過測其多少。

translations.literal: When reed and willow were piled on dikes he measured the amount each time.
translations.idiomatic: Every reed and willow load on the levees he measured himself.

sentences.zh: 與夫役同勞苦，廉不妄取。

translations.literal: He shared hardship with laborers and was incorruptible, taking nothing improperly.
translations.idiomatic: He labored beside the workers, took nothing that was not his due, and stayed clean.

sentences.zh: 河工積弊，端知之，憚於輕發，欲入覲面陳而終不得，以至於敗。

translations.literal: He knew the entrenched abuses of river works but feared speaking lightly; he wished to report in person at court but never obtained audience, and so failed.
translations.idiomatic: He knew the river's entrenched abuses yet hesitated to expose them, hoping to plead in person at court but never getting the chance—and so he failed.

sentences.zh: 繼之者為陳鳳翔，河事遂益敝。

translations.literal: His successor was Chen Fengxiang, and river affairs grew still worse.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Fengxiang followed him, and the rivers slid further into decay.

sentences.zh: 陳鳳翔，字竹香，江西崇仁人。

translations.literal: Chen Fengxiang, style name Zhuxiang, was a native of Chongren, Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Fengxiang, style name Zhuxiang, came from Chongren in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 謄錄，議敘授縣丞，發直隸河工，累遷永定河道。

translations.literal: As a transcription clerk he received appointment as assistant magistrate and was sent to Zhili river works, rising repeatedly to Yongding River Circuit Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: A transcription clerk, he became assistant magistrate on Zhili river works and rose to Yongding River intendant.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶六年，畿輔大水，河決者四，鳳翔從侍郎那彥寶塞決，為仁宗所知。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiaqing the capital region suffered great floods and four river breaks; Fengxiang followed Vice Minister Nayenbao in closing breaches and came to the Jiaqing Emperor's notice.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing six the capital region flooded and four rivers broke. Fengxiang helped Nayenbao seal them and caught the Emperor's eye.

sentences.zh: 逾年，丁父憂，賜金治喪。

translations.literal: After more than a year his father died; he was granted silver for the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: A year later his father died and the court granted funeral silver.

sentences.zh: 後復授永定河道。

translations.literal: Later he was again appointed Yongding River Circuit Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He later returned to the Yongding River intendant post.

sentences.zh: 十四年，擢河東河道總督，逾年，調南河。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was raised to Governor of the Eastern River Conservancy; after more than a year he was transferred to the Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he became Eastern River governor; a year later he moved to the Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 時南河敝壞已久，河湖受病日深，詔以蓄清敵黃為急務，其要在修復高堰之堤，責鳳翔剋期程工，尤以藉黃濟運為戒。

translations.literal: At the time the Southern Rivers had long been decayed and lakes and rivers grew sicker by the day; an edict made storing clear water to resist the Yellow River the urgent task, chiefly repairing the Gaoyan dikes, with Fengxiang given a deadline and especially warned against borrowing Yellow River water for transport.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Rivers were already rotten and the lakes and channels worsening daily. The court made storing clear water against the Yellow River urgent—above all the Gaoyan levees—with a deadline for Fengxiang and a warning not to borrow Yellow River water for transport.

sentences.zh: 十六年，疏陳急治河口及運河各工，高堰二堤亦次第興辦。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he memorialized urgent works at the estuary and Grand Canal, and Gaoyan's two dikes were also begun in turn.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he urged urgent estuary and canal work, and Gaoyan's twin levees were started in sequence.

sentences.zh: 尋偕兩江總督勒保奏報堵合禦黃、鉗口兩壩，疏末微言：「海口北岸無人煙之地，面面皆水，俟秋間水落，相機辦理。」

translations.literal: Soon he jointly reported with Liangjiang Governor-General Lebao that the Yellow-control and pinch dams were closed, ending with a mild note: "On the north bank of the estuary, where no one lives, water lies on every side; after autumn low water we will act as circumstances allow."
translations.idiomatic: He and Governor-General Lebao soon reported the Yellow-control and pinch dams sealed, adding mildly: "On the north bank of the estuary is uninhabited land, water on every side; after autumn low water we will act as circumstances allow."

sentences.zh: 上以上年堵築馬港，兩岸皆新堤，北岸地勢尤高，明是新決諱飾，責令據實奏聞。

translations.literal: The throne, noting that Magang had been closed the previous year with new dikes on both banks and the north bank especially high, saw this as concealing a fresh break and ordered truthful reporting.
translations.idiomatic: The court recalled last year's Magang closure with new dikes on both banks—the north higher than before—and suspected a fresh break being hidden, demanding the truth.

sentences.zh: 適王營減壩土堤又決，詔切責，革職留任。

translations.literal: Just then the Wangying reduction dam earthen dike broke again; a sharp rebuke followed and he was dismissed from rank but kept at his post.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Wangying reduction earthen dike failed again. He was sharply rebuked, stripped of rank, and kept on the works.

sentences.zh: 尋奏：「王營減壩旁注，由海口逼緊，水無他路，致有漫溢。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized: "Overflow beside the Wangying reduction dam came because the estuary was too tight and water had no other path, causing the spread.
translations.idiomatic: He soon wrote: "Wangying overflowed because the mouth was too tight and the water had nowhere else to go.

sentences.zh: 請俟水落，修築減壩海口，但保南岸，勿築北岸，以免水逼。」

translations.literal: I ask that after the water falls we repair the reduction dam and estuary, protecting only the south bank and not building the north bank, lest water be forced too hard."
