translations.idiomatic: After low water, repair the reduction dam and mouth, shore up only the south bank, and leave the north bank unbuilt so the current is not forced."

sentences.zh: 援引高宗諭旨雲梯關外勿與水爭地，詔以「從前瀕海沙灘無居民，今則馬港口外現有村落，非昔可比。

translations.literal: He cited Gaozong's instruction not to contest land with water outside Yuntiguan; an edict replied: "Formerly the seashore sands had no inhabitants; now villages exist beyond Magang—no comparison with the past.
translations.idiomatic: He cited Gaozong's order not to fight the sea for land beyond Yuntiguan. The court replied: "Formerly the seashore sands had no inhabitants; now villages exist beyond Magang—no comparison with the past.

sentences.zh: 且水勢散漫，河緩沙停，弊不勝言。

translations.literal: Moreover the current is scattered, the river slow, and silt piles up—the harm is beyond words.
translations.idiomatic: Besides, the current is scattered, the river sluggish, and silt piles up—the harm is beyond words.

sentences.zh: 又鳳翔等所繪海口圖無村落地名，與十三年吳璥所呈圖說不同，河形曲直亦異。」

translations.literal: Moreover the estuary map Fengxiang and others drew shows no villages or place names, unlike Wu Jing's map and report of the thirteenth year, and the river's curves differ as well."
translations.idiomatic: And Fengxiang's estuary map shows no villages or place names, unlike Wu Jing's thirteenth-year chart, and even the river's bends differ."

sentences.zh: 斥鳳翔意存朦混，恃才妄作：「前稱雲梯關外溜勢暢達，未挑處刷深至十餘丈，可見海口非高仰；

translations.literal: He is rebuked for deliberate confusion and reckless conceit: "Earlier he said currents outside Yuntiguan ran freely and unscoured depths reached more than ten zhang, showing the estuary was not high;
translations.idiomatic: The rebuke continued: he confused matters and acted rashly—"He once said the current beyond Yuntiguan ran freely and unscoured depths exceeded ten zhang, proving the mouth was not high;

sentences.zh: 鳳翔既未身歷其境，今因北岸漫溢，束手無策，反言從前挑築皆屬非計，以相抵塞。」

translations.literal: Fengxiang has not seen the place himself; now with north-bank overflow he is helpless and says earlier dredging and building were all mistakes, merely to parry blame."
translations.idiomatic: yet he has never been there. Now, with north-bank flooding, he is helpless and calls earlier dredging and building all mistakes—only to dodge blame."

sentences.zh: 特簡百齡為兩江總督，與鳳翔同勘海口。

translations.literal: Bailing was specially chosen as Liangjiang Governor-General to survey the estuary with Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Bailing was specially made Liangjiang governor-general to survey the estuary with Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔謂海口不能暢，下壅故上潰，諉為淮海道黎世序所言；

translations.literal: Fengxiang said the estuary could not run freely and blamed upstream choking for the breach, attributing this to Huai-Hai Circuit Intendant Li Shixu;
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang claimed the mouth could not run clear and blamed upstream choking, citing Li Shixu of the Huai-Hai Circuit;

sentences.zh: 而世序實謂下壅在倪家灘新堤上下，非在海口。

translations.literal: but Shixu actually said the choke lay at the new dike above and below Nijiatan, not at the estuary.
translations.idiomatic: Shixu in fact said the choke was at the new dike around Nijiatan, not at the mouth.

sentences.zh: 及百齡至，親勘海口深通，惟中段涸成平陸，乃去歲挑河積土河灘，春水漫刷，仍歸河內。

translations.literal: When Bailing arrived he personally surveyed the estuary and found it deep and clear; only the middle section had dried to level ground—the piled earth from last year's dredging, which spring water would scour back into the channel.
translations.idiomatic: When Bailing came he found the mouth deep and clear; only the middle had dried to flat ground—last year's dredge spoil, which spring floods would scour back in.

sentences.zh: 又攔潮壩放水時，壩根起除未淨，阻水停淤，世序屢請籌辦，鳳翔視為緩圖，詔斥因循貽誤。

translations.literal: When the tide-blocking dam released water, roots left uncleared at the dam base blocked flow and caused silting; Shixu repeatedly asked for remedy but Fengxiang treated it as a distant matter; an edict rebuked his delay and harm.
translations.idiomatic: When the tide dam released water, uncleared roots at its base blocked flow and silted the channel. Shixu urged action repeatedly; Fengxiang treated it as remote. The court rebuked his delay.

sentences.zh: 會上游綿拐山、李家樓兩處漫口，革職留任。

translations.literal: Meanwhile upstream overflows opened at Mianguai Mountain and Lijialou; he was dismissed from rank but kept at his post.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile breaks opened upstream at Mianguai Mountain and Lijialou; he lost rank but stayed on.

sentences.zh: 十七年春，禮壩又決，百齡劾：「鳳翔急開遲閉，壩下衝動，不早親勘堵築，用帑二十七萬兩有奇；

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventeenth year the Li dam broke again; Bailing impeached: "Fengxiang opened too early and closed too late; the current below was churned; he did not inspect and close the breach in person, spending more than 270,000 taels;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth-year spring the Li dam failed again. Bailing impeached: "Fengxiang opened too soon and closed too late, churning the current below without inspecting the closure himself, at a cost of more than 270,000 taels;

sentences.zh: 而壩工未竣，清水大洩，下河成災。」

translations.literal: yet before the dam works were finished clear water drained greatly and the lower river suffered disaster."
translations.idiomatic: yet before the dam was finished clear water drained away and the lower river flooded."

sentences.zh: 嚴詔斥鳳翔貽誤，革職，罰賠銀十萬兩，荷校兩月，遣戍烏魯木齊。

translations.literal: A severe edict rebuked Fengxiang for the harm, dismissed him from office, fined him 100,000 taels of silver, made him wear the cangue for two months, and exiled him to Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: A harsh edict blamed Fengxiang, dismissed him, fined him 100,000 taels, cangued him two months, and sent him to Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 尋鳳翔訴辨，命大學士松筠、府尹初彭齡按訊，得百齡與鳳翔同時批准開壩狀；

translations.literal: Soon Fengxiang appealed; Grand Secretary Songyun and the prefect Chupengling were ordered to investigate and found Bailing had approved opening the dam at the same time as Fengxiang;
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang appealed. Songyun and Prefect Chupengling found Bailing had approved the dam opening at the same moment;

sentences.zh: 鳳翔又訐百齡信任鹽巡道硃爾賡額督辦葦蕩柴料，捏報邀功：譴百齡等，鳳翔免枷，仍赴戍，未行，病歿。

translations.literal: Fengxiang also accused Bailing of trusting salt patrol commissioner Zhu Egen in supervising reed and fuel supplies and fabricating reports for credit: Bailing and others were censured, Fengxiang was freed from the cangue but still sent to exile; before departing he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang also accused Bailing of trusting salt patrol Zhu Egen to pad reed and fuel accounts. Bailing was punished, Fengxiang lost the cangue but still went to exile—and died before he left.

sentences.zh: 黎世序，初名承惠，字湛溪，河南羅山人。

translations.literal: Li Shixu, original name Chenghui, style name Zhanxi, was a native of Luoshan, Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixu, born Chenghui, style name Zhanxi, came from Luoshan in Henan.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年進士，授江西星子知縣，調南昌。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the first year of Jiaqing, he was appointed magistrate of Xingzi in Jiangxi and was transferred to Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: He took his jinshi in Jiaqing one, became magistrate of Xingzi in Jiangxi, and moved to Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 擢江蘇鎮江知府。

translations.literal: He was raised to prefect of Zhenjiang in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to prefect of Zhenjiang in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 十六年，遷淮海道。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to Huai-Hai Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he became Huai-Hai Circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 與河督陳鳳翔爭堵倪家灘漫口，由是知名。

translations.literal: He disputed closing the Nijiatan overflow with River Governor Chen Fengxiang and thereby became well known.
translations.idiomatic: He clashed with River Governor Chen Fengxiang over sealing Nijiatan and made a name for himself.

sentences.zh: 十七年，調淮陽道。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Huaiyang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he moved to Huaiyang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 尋鳳翔黜，詔加世序三品頂戴，署南河河道總督，俟三年後果稱職，始實授。

translations.literal: Soon after Fengxiang was removed, an edict added third-rank peacock feathers for Shixu and made him acting Southern River governor, with substantive appointment after three years if he proved competent.
translations.idiomatic: When Fengxiang fell, Shixu received third-rank feathers and acted as Southern River governor, with a full appointment after three years if he proved fit.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「自上年大濬，千里長河，王營減壩及李家樓漫口堵合，雲梯關外水深二三丈至四五丈，為近年所未有。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Since last year's great dredging, along the thousand-li channel the Wangying reduction dam and Lijialou overflow were closed, and outside Yuntiguan water depth reached two or three zhang to four or five zhang—unseen in recent years.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "Since last year's great dredging, with Wangying and Lijialou sealed, water outside Yuntiguan ran two to five zhang deep—depths not seen in years.

sentences.zh: 而清江浦至雲梯關一帶，較之河底深通時尚高八九尺。

translations.literal: Yet from Qingjiangpu to Yuntiguan the level is still eight or nine chi higher than when the river bottom was fully clear.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from Qingjiangpu to Yuntiguan the surface still stands eight or nine chi above the fully scoured bed.

sentences.zh: 此非人力所能猝辦，計惟竭力收蓄湖水，以期暢出。

translations.literal: This cannot be solved at once by human effort; the plan is to store lake water with all possible strength so it may run out freely.
translations.idiomatic: No crew can fix that overnight; we must hoard lake water with all our strength so it can pour out freely.

sentences.zh: 敵黃蓄清之法，在堰、盱二堤，有旨緩辦；

translations.literal: The method of resisting the Yellow River with clear water lies in the Yan and Xu dikes; an edict had deferred this;
translations.idiomatic: Clear water against the Yellow River depends on the Yan and Xu levees, though the court had deferred them;

sentences.zh: 今年禮壩跌損，宣洩路少，二隄尤應急築，以資捍衛。」

translations.literal: this year the Li dam is damaged and discharge paths are few; the two dikes especially need urgent building for defense."
translations.idiomatic: this year the Li dam is broken and outlets are few—the two levees need urgent rebuilding for defense."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 十八年，以仁、義、禮三壩基壞，請於蔣家壩附近山岡移建三壩，挑引河三道，詔令詳議，並飭填實舊壩。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, because the Ren, Yi, and Li dam foundations were ruined, he asked to move the three dams to a nearby hill at Jiangjiaba with three diversion channels; an edict ordered detailed deliberation and filling in the old dams solidly.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, with the Ren, Yi, and Li foundations ruined, he proposed relocating the three dams to hills near Jiangjiaba with three diversions. The court ordered study and solid filling of the old dams.

sentences.zh: 尋如議行。

translations.literal: Soon the plan was carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The plan soon went ahead.

sentences.zh: 因全漕渡黃較早，議敘。

translations.literal: Because the entire grain transport crossed the Yellow River earlier than usual, he was recommended for reward.
translations.idiomatic: The full grain fleet crossed the Yellow River earlier than usual, and he was put forward for reward.

sentences.zh: 疏請加高徐州護城石工，添築越堤，於清江浦汰黃堤外加重堤，又於駱馬湖尾閭五壩迤下添碎石滾壩，並允之。

translations.literal: He memorialized to heighten the Xuzhou city-protection stone works, add overflow dikes, build a heavier dike outside the Yellow River-sifting dike at Qingjiangpu, and add a stone rolling dam below the five dams at the tail of Luoma Lake; all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to raise Xuzhou's stone flood-protection works, add overflow levees, thicken the dike outside Qingjiangpu's Yellow River silt-control dike, and add a stone rolling dam below Luoma Lake's five dams—all approved.

sentences.zh: 先是百齡擬於清江浦石馬頭築圈堤，其灣處對王營，上起禦黃壩，下屬貼心壩，河寬千餘丈，至此陡束為二百丈，論者以為不便，得不行；

translations.literal: Earlier Bailing had planned an encircling dike at the Shima head at Qingjiangpu; at the bend opposite Wangying it would run from the Yellow-control dam to the Tixin dam, narrowing a thousand-plus-zhang river to two hundred zhang; critics said it was impractical and it was not done;
translations.idiomatic: Bailing had wanted an encircling dike at Qingjiangpu's Shima head, pinching a thousand-zhang river to two hundred opposite Wangying from the Yellow-control dam to Tixin; critics blocked it;

sentences.zh: 世序卒成之。

translations.literal: Shixu finally completed it.
translations.idiomatic: Shixu finished it at last.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，睢南薛家樓、桃北丁家莊漫水壞堤，世序躍入河者再。

translations.literal: That autumn overflows at Xuejialou south of Suizhou and Dingjiazhuang north of Tao damaged dikes; Shixu leaped into the river twice.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn breaks at Xuejialou and Dingjiazhuang damaged levees; Shixu jumped into the river twice.

sentences.zh: 會上游河南睢州決口奪溜，河水陡落，睢、桃兩工得補築無事，詔以世序不能先事預防，降一級留任。

translations.literal: When upstream the Suizhou break in Henan seized the current, river water fell sharply and the Suizhou and Tao works could be patched without disaster; an edict held that Shixu had failed to prevent matters beforehand and demoted him one grade while keeping him at his post.
translations.idiomatic: When Suizhou upstream in Henan stole the current, levels plunged and the Suizhou and Tao sites could be patched safely. The court said he should have foreseen it and demoted him one rank while keeping him on.

sentences.zh: 睢州決口久未合，黃水全入洪湖。

translations.literal: The Suizhou breach long remained open and Yellow River water fully entered Hongze Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Suizhou stayed open for long, and Yellow River water poured fully into Hongze.

sentences.zh: 世序力籌宣洩，濬順清河於清口淤窄處，自束清壩起至禦黃壩止，挑引河三，束清、鉗口各壩一律闢展，智、仁兩壩及蔣壩以南，新挑仁、義兩壩引河，並為分減之路。

translations.literal: Shixu worked hard on discharge, dredging the narrow silt at Qingkou on the Shunqing River from the Shuqing dam to the Yellow-control dam, cutting three diversions, widening all Shuqing and pinch dams, and opening new Ren and Yi diversion channels south of Jiangba as additional relief paths.
translations.idiomatic: Shixu labored to release water: dredging Qingkou's Shunqing channel from Shuqing to Yellow-control, cutting three diversions, widening every dam, and adding Ren and Yi outlets south of Jiangba.

sentences.zh: 至十九年霜降，安瀾，詔嘉世序修防得宜，加二品頂戴。

translations.literal: By the frost descent of the nineteenth year calm was restored; an edict praised Shixu's sound repairs and added second-rank peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: By the nineteenth-year frost the rivers stood calm. The court praised his repairs and gave him second-rank feathers.

sentences.zh: 二十年，疏言：「徐州十八里屯舊有東西兩閘，金門寬三丈五尺，不足減水。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he memorialized: "At Xuzhou Shibalicun the old east and west sluices have gates only three zhang five chi wide—insufficient to reduce water.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he wrote: "At Xuzhou Shibalicun the old east and west gates are only three zhang five chi wide—too narrow to bleed flow.

sentences.zh: 其西南虎山腰兩山對峙，凹處寬二十餘丈，山根石腳相連，可作天然滾壩。

translations.literal: Southwest at Hushanyao two mountains face each other with a twenty-plus-zhang hollow; the stone roots at the mountain feet connect and can serve as a natural rolling dam.
translations.idiomatic: At Hushanyao southwest two mountains face a hollow twenty-odd zhang wide; their stone roots meet and can form a natural rolling dam.

sentences.zh: 北面臨河，即十八里屯，山岡淤於土中，剝平山頂，改作臨河滾壩。

translations.literal: To the north along the river lies Shibalicun; the hill is buried in silt; stripping the summit can make a riverside rolling dam.
translations.idiomatic: North along the river at Shibalicun the hill lies under silt; stripping the top can yield a riverside rolling dam.

sentences.zh: 以虎山腰為重門擎托，可期穩固。」

translations.literal: With Hushanyao as a heavy gate to brace it, stability may be expected."
translations.idiomatic: With Hushanyao as a second gate to brace it, the work should hold."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 夏，洪湖盛漲，拆展束清，禦黃兩壩，啟山盱引河滾壩，清水暢出，會黃東注，刷河益深，特詔嘉獎，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In summer Hongze rose greatly; the Shuqing and Yellow-control dams were dismantled and widened, the Shanxu diversion rolling dam was opened, clear water ran freely, met the Yellow River flowing east, and scoured the channel deeper; a special edict praised him and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Hongze surged. He widened Shuqing and Yellow-control, opened the Shanxu rolling dam, let clear water run freely to meet the Yellow River eastward and scour deeper, and won special praise and the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 世序治河，力舉束水對壩，課種柳株，驗土埽，稽垛牛，減漕規例價。

translations.literal: In managing rivers Shixu stressed confining water against dams, planting willow stakes, inspecting earth revetments, checking oxen for earth piles, and reducing the standard prices for transport quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Shixu ran rivers by confining water against dams, planting willows, inspecting revetments, counting oxen and earth piles, and cutting transport quota prices.

sentences.zh: 行之既久，灘柳茂密，土料如林，工修河暢。

translations.literal: After long practice the bank willows were dense, earth materials like forests, works sound, and the river ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: Over time the bank willows thickened, earth stockpiled like woods, works held, and the channel ran clear.

sentences.zh: 南河歲修三百萬兩為率，每年必節省二三十萬。

translations.literal: Southern River annual repairs averaged three million taels; each year he saved two or three hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Southern River repairs averaged three million taels a year; he saved two or three hundred thousand annually.

sentences.zh: 碎石坦坡，自靳輔始用之於高堰，後蘭第錫、吳璥、徐端偶一用之；

translations.literal: Stone slope revetments began with Jin Fu at Gaoyan; later Landi Xi, Wu Jing, and Xu Duan used them only occasionally;
translations.idiomatic: Stone slope revetments began with Jin Fu at Gaoyan; Landi Xi, Wu Jing, and Xu Duan used them only now and then;

sentences.zh: 世序始用之於通工，謗言四起，世序力持，卒獲其效。

translations.literal: Shixu first applied them throughout the works; slander arose on all sides, but he held firm and finally achieved success.
translations.idiomatic: Shixu applied them across the works. Critics howled, but he held firm and succeeded.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，京察，議敘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, at the capital personnel review, he was recommended for reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was recommended for reward at the capital review.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，因禦黃壩刷深不能施工，束清壩掣溜太急，亦難穩立，請於舊二壩水淺處添築重壩，又於束清壩外添建一壩，以為重門鉗束，於是比歲安瀾，奏減料價一成。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, because the Yellow-control dam scoured too deep for work and the Shuqing dam's current was too swift to stand firm, he asked to add a heavy dam where the old two dams were shallow and build another dam outside Shuqing as a double gate; calm followed year after year and he memorialized to reduce material prices by ten percent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, with Yellow-control scoured too deep to build and Shuqing's current too fierce, he added a heavy dam on the old shallow site and an outer Shuqing dam as a double gate. Year after year the river held calm, and he cut material prices ten percent.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，入覲，宣宗嘉其勞勚，加太子少保，開復一切處分，賜詩以寵之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he attended court; the Xuanzong Emperor praised his labor, made him Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, restored all penalties, and bestowed an imperial poem in honor.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang one he came to court. The Xuanzong Emperor praised his service, made him Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, restored every penalty, and gave him an imperial poem.

sentences.zh: 二年，京察，复予議敘。

translations.literal: In the second year, at the capital review, he was again recommended for reward.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang two he was again recommended at the capital review.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒於官，優詔褒卹，加尚書銜，贈太子太保，諡襄勤，入祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died in office; a favorable edict praised and compensated him, added minister rank, posthumously made him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, gave the posthumous title Xiangqin, and enshrined him in the Temple of Eminent Statesmen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died in office. The court mourned him richly, raised him to minister rank posthumously, made him Grand Guardian with the temple name Xiangqin, and enshrined him among eminent statesmen.

sentences.zh: 江南請祀名宦建專祠，帝追念前勞，御製詩一章，命勒石於墓。

translations.literal: Jiangnan asked to enshrine him as a local notable in a dedicated shrine; the Emperor, recalling his past service, composed an imperial poem and ordered it carved on his tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan sought a local shrine; remembering his service, the Emperor wrote a poem and ordered it carved on his tomb.

sentences.zh: 賜其子學淳，主事；

translations.literal: His son Xuechun was granted a secretary post;
translations.idiomatic: His son Xuechun received a secretary post;

sentences.zh: 學淵，舉人；

translations.literal: Xueyuan, a juren;
translations.idiomatic: Xueyuan, a juren;

sentences.zh: 學澄，副榜貢生。

translations.literal: Xuecheng, a provincial graduate with tribute student status.
translations.idiomatic: Xuecheng, a provincial graduate presented as tribute student.

sentences.zh: 自乾隆季年，河官習為奢侈，帑多中飽，浸至無歲不決；

translations.literal: From the late Qianlong reign river officials grew accustomed to luxury, much treasury silver was embezzled, and breaks came almost every year;
translations.idiomatic: Late in Qianlong, river officers turned lavish, treasury funds vanished into pockets, and the river broke almost every year;

sentences.zh: 又以漕運牽掣，當其事者，無不蹶敗。

translations.literal: and because grain transport was always at stake, whoever took charge invariably stumbled to defeat.
translations.idiomatic: and with the grain fleet always at stake, whoever took charge usually fell.

sentences.zh: 世序澹泊寧靜，一湔靡俗。

translations.literal: Shixu was plain and tranquil and washed away the decadent customs.
translations.idiomatic: Shixu was plain-spoken and calm, and scrubbed away the rotten habits.

sentences.zh: 任事十三年，獨以恩禮終焉。

translations.literal: He served thirteen years and alone ended his career with imperial favor.
translations.idiomatic: He served thirteen years and alone finished with the court's favor.

sentences.zh: 幕僚鄒汝翼，無錫人，世序倚如左右手，欲援陳潢故事，薦之於朝，力辭而止。

translations.literal: His staff adviser Zou Ruyi, a native of Wuxi, was relied on like his right hand; he wished to follow the precedent of Chen Huang and recommend him to court, but Ruyi firmly declined and the matter stopped.
translations.idiomatic: His aide Zou Ruyi of Wuxi was trusted like a right hand. Shixu meant to follow Chen Huang's precedent and recommend him, but Ruyi refused and the plan died.

sentences.zh: 涇縣包世臣號知河事，世序多用其說，惟築圈堰一事論不合。

translations.literal: Bao Shichen of Jing County, who styled himself expert in river affairs, had many of his views adopted by Shixu, except on building the encircling weir, where they disagreed.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Shichen of Jing, who claimed river expertise, shaped much of Shixu's policy—except the encircling weir, where they split.

sentences.zh: 及創虎山腰滾壩，世臣阻之曰：「河以無溜為至險，攻大埽不與焉；

translations.literal: When the Hushanyao rolling dam was proposed, Shichen objected: "A river's greatest peril is having no current; attacking great revetments does not compare;
translations.idiomatic: When Shixu proposed the Hushanyao rolling dam, Bao objected: "A river's worst danger is losing its current—great revetments are not the whole story;

sentences.zh: 湖以淤底為至險，掣石工不與焉。

translations.literal: a lake's greatest peril is a silted bottom; pulling stone works does not compare.
translations.idiomatic: a lake's worst danger is a silted bed—stone works are not the whole story either.

sentences.zh: 公謂減黃入湖，為化險為平。

translations.literal: You say reducing Yellow River water into the lake turns peril into safety.
translations.idiomatic: You say bleeding Yellow River water into the lake turns danger into safety.

sentences.zh: 黃緩湖高，吾坐見其積平成險也。

translations.literal: When the Yellow River eases and the lake rises, I foresee flat ground piling into peril again.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow River slackens and the lake rises, I see flat silt turning back into danger.

sentences.zh: 兩險交至，其禍甚烈。

translations.literal: When both perils arrive together, the disaster will be fierce.
translations.idiomatic: When both dangers meet, the disaster will be fierce.

sentences.zh: 公意在及身，然以憂患貽後世已。」

translations.literal: Your aim may be to finish in your own lifetime, yet you already bequeath trouble to later ages."
translations.idiomatic: You may mean to finish in your own day, but you are already leaving trouble to posterity."

sentences.zh: 世序初奏亦謂壩成遇不得已乃啟，然後實無歲不啟。

translations.literal: Shixu's first memorial also said the dam would be opened only when unavoidable, yet in practice it was opened every year without fail.
translations.idiomatic: Shixu's first report said the dam would open only when unavoidable—yet in practice it opened every year.

sentences.zh: 洎嘉慶二十五年，上游河南睢州馬營兩口既合，閱歲大汛至，清河、安東、阜寧三縣境內河水常平堤，而中泓無溜。

translations.literal: By the twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing, after the two breaches at Suizhou and Maying in Henan upstream were closed, when the great flood season came the next year, within Qinghe, Andong, and Funing the river stood level with the dikes yet the main channel had no current.
translations.idiomatic: By Jiaqing twenty-five, after Suizhou and Maying upstream were sealed, the next great flood season brought level water against the levees in Qinghe, Andong, and Funing—yet no current in the main channel.

sentences.zh: 世序心知其害，憂瘁而卒。

translations.literal: Shixu knew the harm in his heart, grieved himself ill, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Shixu saw the harm clearly, grieved himself to death.

sentences.zh: 後數月，高堰竟決。

translations.literal: A few months later the Gaoyan weir broke after all.
translations.idiomatic: Months later the Gaoyan weir broke.

sentences.zh: 論曰：仁宗銳意治河，用人其慎。

translations.literal: The commentary says: The Jiaqing Emperor was keen to govern the rivers and cautious in choosing men.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Emperor Ren was earnest about the rivers and careful in choosing men.

sentences.zh: 然承積弊之後，求治愈殷，窟穴於弊者轉益譸張以為嘗試。

translations.literal: Yet after accumulated abuses, the more urgently cure was sought, the more those who lived on corruption grew bold in denouncing every attempt as reckless experiment.
translations.idiomatic: Yet amid entrenched abuses, the harder he pressed for cure, the bolder corruption's beneficiaries grew in calling every try reckless.

sentences.zh: 海口改道之說起，紛紜數載而後定。

translations.literal: When debate arose over changing the estuary course, confusion lasted several years before a decision was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Debate over shifting the estuary raged for years before a decision held.

sentences.zh: 康基田、徐端等皆諳習河事，程功亦僅。

translations.literal: Kang Jitian, Xu Duan, and others were all versed in river affairs, yet their achievements were limited.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Jitian, Xu Duan, and others knew the rivers well, yet achieved only modest success.

sentences.zh: 至黎世序宣勤久任，南河乃安；

translations.literal: Only when Li Shixu labored long in devoted service did the Southern Rivers grow calm;
translations.idiomatic: Only when Li Shixu served long with steady exertion did the Southern Rivers settle;

sentences.zh: 而減黃病湖，遂遺隱患。

translations.literal: yet reducing the Yellow River harmed the lakes and left a hidden peril behind.
translations.idiomatic: yet bleeding the Yellow River hurt the lakes and left a hidden peril.

sentences.zh: 得失之故，具於斯焉。

translations.literal: The reasons for gain and loss are set forth here.
translations.idiomatic: The reasons for success and failure are told here.
